Privacy Policy — My Pings

Last updated: August 2026 · Version 0.1.0

My Pings is a Chrome extension by AI4Context. It shows an on-demand list of alerts from sources you choose (starting with RSS/Atom feeds).

Data we process

  • Feed URLs and titles you add, plus items fetched from those feeds (title, link, dates), stored in chrome.storage.local on your device.
  • UI language preference and read/unread state for list items.
  • When you refresh or add a feed, the extension requests host access and fetches that feed URL over HTTPS/HTTP.

What we do not do

  • We do not read your operating-system notification center.
  • We do not monitor browsing in the background.
  • We do not upload your feed list or ping items to AI4Context servers in v0.1.
  • We do not sell your data.

Permissions

  • storage — local sources, pings, and preferences.
  • Optional host access — only for feed origins you add, so the extension can download those feeds.
